D8 ADVANCE – The Future Proof X-Ray Diffractometer
Bruker's D8 ADVANCE is based on the unique D8 XRD family platform and is perfectly designed for all X-ray powder diffraction and scattering applications including:
Traditional X-ray powder diffraction (XRD)
Pair Distribution Function (PDF) analysis
Small and Wide Angle X-ray Scattering (SAXS, WAXS)
Due to its superb adaptability, the D8 ADVANCE has the ability to measure all sample types, from liquids to loose powders, from thin films to solid blocks, on a single instrument.
No matter if you are a novice or an expert user, configuration changes are quick, easy and fool-proof. All of this is made possible by Bruker's unique DAVINCI.DESIGN: Tool- and alignment-free changes of the instrument configuration, supported by automatic, real-time component recognition and validation.
Even more - only Bruker offers an alignment guarantee over the entire angular range for all instrument geometries and wavelengths. There is no other powder diffractometer on the market exceeding the accuracy of a D8 ADVANCE in terms of peak positions, intensities, and resolution.

The D8 ADVANCE is an adaptable X-ray diffraction platform for XRD, PDF, SAXS and WAXS
 Contact an Expert
Markets for the D8 ADVANCE 
 Metals
 Retained austenite, residual stress and texture are just a few of the techniques typically performed on metal samples to ensure final product meets end user needs.
 Thin Film Metrology
 Samples ranging from micron thick coatings to nm epitaxial films benefit from a range of techniques to assess crystal quality, film thickness, composition epitaxial arrangement and strain relaxation.
 Building Materials
 From raw materials to quality control, XRD plays a key role in ensuring high yield of the intended product including clinker analysis and reaction monitoring.
 Pharmaceuticals
 From discovery through production, the Bruker D8 ADVANCE supports the full life cycle including structure determination, positive material identification, formulation quantification and non-ambient stability testing.
 Chemicals/Pigments
 The determination of new structures or quantification of mixtures is commonly performed on a wide range of industrial materials including analysis of both major and minor phase components.
Energy Storage/Batteries
 With the D8 ADVANCE, battery materials can be tested under in-situ/in-operando cycling conditions, delivering direct insights into the changing crystal structure and phase composition of energy storage materials.
Key Features of the D8 ADVANCE
D8 ADVANCE
TWIN / TWIN optics
The patented TWIN / TWIN optics beam path design greatly simplifies the usage of the D8 ADVANCE, allowing a large variety of applications and sample types. With user convenience in mind, the system features automatic, motorized switching between 4 different beam geometries. 
Without manual user intervention, the system is capable of switching between focusing Bragg-Brentano for powders and parallel-beam geometry for ill-shaped samples, coatings, and thin films and everything in-between. It is perfectly suited for all sample types including powder, bulk, fiber, sheet and thin-film (amorphous, polycrystalline and epitaxial) under ambient or non-ambient conditions.
 READ MORE ABOUT TWIN OPTICS 
D8 ADVANCE 
Dynamic Beam Optimization™ (DBO)
Bruker's unique DBO feature sets a significant new benchmark in terms of data quality for X-ray diffraction. The automatic synchronization of motorized divergence slits, a motorized anti-scatter screen, and the variable field-of-view active detector window provides unparalleled data quality, specifically at low angles 2Ɵ. DBO is supported by all members of the LYNXEYE detector family: SSD160-2, LYNXEYE-2, and LYNXEYE XE-T.
 Watch the video on DBO 
The LYNXEYE XE-T is the flagship within the LYNXEYE family of detectors. The LYNXEYE XE-T is the only energy dispersive detector on the market for acquisition of 0D, 1D and 2D data. Suited for all wavelengths (from Cr to Ag), with highest count rate capability and best angular resolution, the detector is ideal for all X-ray diffraction and scattering applications.
The superb energy resolution of the LYNXEYE XE-T, better than 380 eV, makes it the highest performing detector system on the market in terms of fluorescence filtering. With the LYNXEYE XE-T detector Fe fluorecense excited by Cu radiation is filtered 100% at zero intensity loss and there is no need for metal filters causing artifacts in the data such as remnant Kß and absorption edges. Also there is no more need for intensity-killing secondary monochromators.
The LYNXEYE XE-T is covered by Brukers unique detector warranty: No defective channels at delivery time. Guaranteed!
 READ MORE ABOUT THE LYNXEYE XE-T
 Contact an Expert
Additional Features of the D8 ADVANCE
 DAVINCI.DESIGN
 Fail-safe and alignment free beam path component changes thanks to high-precision snap-lock mechanism, 3-point support optics mount, and unique ID chip featuring component recognition.
Dynamic Beam Optimization
 Best powder data automatically. Just input sample size and DBO dynamically adjusts the motorized divergence slits, motorized anti-scatter screen, and variable active detector window.
 LYNXEYE XE-T
 LYNXEYE XE-T for 0D, 1D and 2D data acquisition featuring always active exceptional energy discrimination without signal loss of traditional secondary monochromators.
 TRIO and TWIN optics
 Fully automatic, motorized switching between up to 6 different beam geometries without manual user intervention. 
EIGER2 R family of detectors
 EIGER2 R Detector with panoramic Soller slit assembly and evacuated flight tube for 0D, 1D, and 2D data acquisition
 The Solution for your Compliant Lab
 cGAMP, 21CFR Part11, and EU Annex11 compliant solutions paired with equipment qualification services
Instrument and Data Quality
 Bruker's unique instrument alignment guarantee ensures the entire system, not just individual components, meets the high standards described in the Instrument Performance Verification Booklet
One Diffractometer - All Applications
D8 ADVANCE Applications
Powder Diffraction
X-ray powder diffraction (XRPD) techniques are among the most important tools for materials characterization. Much of the information embedded in a powder pattern is derived directly from the atomic arrangement of the phases present. The D8 ADVANCE and the DIFFRAC.SUITE software allow support simple execution of common XRPD methods: 
Identification of both crystalline and amorphous phases and determination of specimen purity
Quantitative analysis of both crystalline and amorphous phases in multi-phase mixtures
Microstructure analysis (crystallite size, microstrain, disorder…)
Bulk residual stress resulting from thermal treatment or machining in manufactured components
Texture (preferred orientation) analysis
Indexing, ab-initio crystal structure determination and crystal structure refinement 
D8 ADVANCE Applications
Pair Distribution Function Analysis
Pair distribution function (PDF) analysis is an analytical technique that provides structural information from disordered materials based on Bragg as well as diffuse scattering ("Total Scattering"). While Bragg peaks provide information about the average crystal structure of a material (i.e. long range order), diffuse scattering allows characterization of its local structure (i.e. short range order).
The D8 ADVANCE and TOPAS software represent the highest performing PDF analysis solutions on the market in terms of analysis speed, data quality and results for analysis of amorphous, poorly crystalline, nano-crystalline or nano-structured materials:
Phase identification
Structure determination and refinement
Nano particle size and shape
D8 ADVANCE Applications
Thin Films and Coatings
Analysis of thin films and coatings is based on the same principles of XRPD, but with further beam conditioning and angular control. Typical examples include, but are not limited to, phase identification, crystalline quality, residual stress, texture analysis, thickness determination and composition vs strain analysis. Analysis of thin films and coatings is focusing on properties of layered materials with nm to µm thickness, ranging from amorphous and poly-crystalline coatings to epitaxially grown films. The D8 ADVANCE and the DIFFRAC.SUITE software enable high quality analyses of thin films including: 
Grazing incidence diffraction
X-Ray Reflectometry
High resolution X-ray diffraction
Reciprocal space mapping 
 Contact an Expert
Further Applications of the D8 ADVANCE
 Phase Identification
 One of the most commonly used applications is positive material identification (PMI) with sensitivity to the atomic structure, not possible with elemental analysis techniques.
 Phase Quantification
 Methods include semi-quantitative analysis in EVA, area methods in DQUANT and full pattern analysis in DIFFRAC.TOPAS 
Pair Distribution Function Generation and Refinement 
 DIFFRAC.TOPAS represents a true "raw-data-to-PDF-refinement" solution by integrating unique PDF generation and refinement methodologies.
 Non-Ambient XRD
 Temperature profiles can be configured and synchronized with measurements in DIFFRAC.WIZARD then the results can be visualized in DIFFRAC.EVA.
 Texture Analysis
 Generation of pole figures, orientation distribution function (ODF) and volumetric quantification in DIFFRAC.TEXTURE using both spherical harmonics and component methods
 Residual Stress Analysis
 Residual stress of a steel component with DIFFRAC.LEPTOS measured with Cr radiation with the sin2psi method.
 X-Ray Reflectometry (XRR)
 XRR Analysis in DIFFRAC.LEPTOS of a multilayer sample for film thickness, interfacial roughness and density.
 Small Angle X-ray Scattering (SAXS)
 Particle size analysis in DIFFRAC.SAXS of NIST SRM 8011 9 nm gold nanoparticles collected with the EIGER2 R 500K in 2D mode.

XRD Components
Bruker XRD solutions consist of high performance components configured to meet the analytical requirements. The modular design is the key to configure the best instrumentation. 
All categories of components are part of Bruker’s key competence, developed and manufactured by Bruker AXS, or in close cooperation with third party vendors. 
Bruker XRD components are available for upgrading the installed X-ray systems for improving their performance.

PLAN.MEASURE.ANALYZE with DIFFRAC.SUITE
DIFFRAC.SUITE™ offers a wide range of software modules for easy X-ray powder diffraction data acquisition and evaluation. Based on Microsoft's .NET technology, DIFFRAC.SUITE offers all the advantages of modern software technology for stability, maximum ease of use and networking. 
The fully customizable user-interface is characterized by a plug-in framework, providing a common look, feel and operation. All measurement and evaluation software modules can be operated as individual applications or integrated together in DIFFRAC.SUITE's plug-in framework. Unlimited networking allows access and control of any number of D6 PHASER, D8 ADVANCE, D8 DISCOVER and D8 ENDEAVOR diffractometers within a customer's network.

Bruker Alignment Guarantee
Bruker is committed to not only provide you with the best possible instrumentation, but also to certify both highest hardware and data quality.
The Benchmark in X-ray Powder Diffraction Data Quality
Only the highest data quality can adequately represent both the value of your samples and your effort. Bruker’s quality assurance measures give you the certainty that your data is correct.
Bruker is committed to not only provide you with the best possible instrumentation, but also to certify both highest hardware and data quality. Each single instrument must successfully pass the Bruker instrument verification procedure since its introduction in 2003.
Alignment Guarantee for all D8 Diffractometers
Bruker has long been a leader in delivering the highest standards of instrument and data quality. The D8 ENDEAVOR, D8 ADVANCE family, and D8 DISCOVER stand out with a unique alignment guarantee, ensuring precision across all instrument geometries and wavelengths — as outlined in the respective Instrument Performance Verification Booklets. Unlike standard calibration practices, Bruker’s alignment guarantee specifically focuses on the meticulous alignment of hardware, not just the calibration of the angular scale. Every instrument undergoes rigorous alignment testing both before delivery and during installation, certifying unparalleled data quality: 
For Cr, Co, and Cu systems: Peak position accuracy is ≤±0.01° 2Theta (150 mm measurement height) across the entire angular range, based on the NIST Standard Reference Material (SRM) 1976.
For Mo and Ag systems: Peak position accuracy is ≤±0.02° 2Theta (150 mm measurement height) across the entire angular range, based on the Bruker Tungsten Reference Material. 
Particularly demanding applications require even more accurate and reliable peak positions. The D8 DISCOVER Plus with ATLAS pushes spatial accuracy even further: 
Highest data quality in both the equatorial and axial planes thanks to superior beam stability
For Cu and Co systems: Peak position accuracy is ≤±0.007° 2Theta across the entire angular range, based on the NIST Standard Reference Material (SRM) 1976. 
The most current NIST SRM 1976 and / or Bruker Tungsten Reference Material are always included with an instrument, as applicable. 
Optionally, all necessary procedures are available to easily comply with cGMP requirements, facilitating Operational Qualification (OQ) and Performance Qualification (PQ). 
 Read more on Alignment Guarantee
The ATLAS Goniometer: Industry Leading Accuracy – Guaranteed!
For particularly demanding applications that require even more accurate and reliable peak positions, shape and intensity, Bruker takes data quality to the next level: the advanced goniometer design of the ATLAS delivers the highest angular positioning accuracy, increasing the reliability of measured data. At the heart of every D8 DISCOVER Plus solution, the ATLAS pushes the complete solution alignment guarantee even further:
Guaranteed angular accuracy ≤ ±0.007° 2Theta over the entire angular range determined on the peak position of NIST SRM 1976
Increased spatial accuracy providing highest beam position stability in both the equatorial and axial planes
Verification of the certified relative intensities and instrument resolution (FWHM)
Optional IQOQ procedures for regulated industries such as the pharma industry based on the instrument verification booklet, facilitating operational qualification (OQ) after installation of upgrades or repairs performance qualification (PQ) at any time.
D6 PHASER - No need for benchtop compromises
The D6 PHASER offers unrivaled data quality and acquisition speed in a benchtop X-ray diffraction system. It is the perfect solution for all powder diffraction applications from phase identification and quantitative phase analysis to crystal structure and PDF analysis due to its superior resolution, low angle and low background performance.
Bruker AXS also guarantees unparalleled instrument accuracy of ±0.01° 2Theta or better over the angular range using verified Bruker alignment standards. A rigorous instrument verification protocol ensures accurate and precise data for all applications.

XRD Optics
X-rays generated by the source are shaped by optics into a useful X-ray beam, optimized for the size and shape of the sample and the application. Bruker AXS’ comprehensive portfolio includes single-crystal type optics such as Johansson and channel-cut monochromators, polycapillary lenses, and in particular multi-layer optics. 
 Bruker Store
Alignment- and tool-free optics change
DIFFRAC.DAVINCI and SNAP-LOCK
You need to accept cookies to play this video.
 Cookies Settings
DAVINCI.SNAP-LOCK is our unique, high-precision mechanism, which enables all the optics to be exchanged within just a few seconds, without tools and without requiring adjustment. All optics return to perfect alignment every time. In addition, the DAVINCI.MODE registers every optics on the system with its specific characteristics and configures it automatically. Each component, replacement and status change is instantly recognized and visualized on the virtual goniometer of the DIFFRAC.DAVINCI software plugin, which also reports any configuration conflicts.
Changing configurations has never been so easy, fast and reliable. 
For ultimate ease-of-use we have gone even a step further and developed the TWIN/TWIN, TRIO and PATHFINDER optics, all incorporating multiple beam path modules available at the touch of a button.  
Push-button switch of instrument geometries
TWIN-TWIN
With the pioneering TWIN/TWIN design switching between four different instrument geometries is done with the push of a button, reliably and without user intervention. Experience effortless change from classic powder diffraction applications to amorphous and polycrystalline thin-film analysis.
The primary TWIN optic features a motorized divergence slit for Bragg-Brentano geometry and a Göbel mirror for the parallel beam geometry.
The secondary TWIN optic implements both the appropriate motorized anti-scatter slit for Bragg-Brentano, and an equatorial Soller slit for parallel beam geometry.
 READ MORE IN D8 ADVANCE BROCHURE
 TWIN/TWIN setup for Bragg-Brentano geometry
 TWIN/TWIN setup for grazing incidence diffraction
 TWIN/TWIN setup for reflectometry
 TWIN/TWIN setup for microdiffraction
Maximum flexibility meets unparalleled ease-of-use
TRIO
The patented TRIO optics uniquely enables pushbutton, automated switching between up to six different beam geometries when combined with the secondary TWIN optics. Switch between the three most commonly used primary beam geometries without user intervention:
Motorized slits for a focused beam geometry used for conventional Bragg-Brentano powder diffraction
Göbel Mirror for high intensity Cu-Kα parallel beam for capillary experiments, height insensitive measurements, surface sensitive grazing incidence geometry, coating thickness determination and micro-diffraction
Göbel Mirror + 2-Bounce Ge Channelcut monochromator for highly parallel Cu-Kα1 beam for high-resolution diffraction (HRXRD) of epitaxial thin films and pure Kα1 diffraction patterns of powder samples
 READ MORE IN D8 ADVANCE BROCHURE
 High resolution X-ray Diffraction (HRXRD) setup
 Parallel Beam geometry setup
 Set-up for transmission geometry and Small Angle X-ray Scattering (SAXS)
 X-ray reflectivity (XRR) measurement geometry
 TRIO/TWIN set-up for Bragg-Brentano
 Set-up for grazing incidence diffraction (GID)
MASTER IN THIN FILM APPLICATIONS
PATHFINDER Plus
The PATHFINDERPlus optics allows switching between double-axis and triple-axis geometries with a simple mouse-click. Designed with an extra large aperture, the PATHFINDERPlus optics uses the entire field of view of the LYNXEYE detector family. The PATHFINDERPlus optics offers unprecedented flexibility and seamless measurements - including fully automated sample alignment – over the full range of samples in thin film analysis and research:
Motorized slit for high flux measurements: XRR and HRXRD investigations on samples with low mosaicity or samples with strongly tilted layers.
2-bounce analyzer crystal for applications that require high resolution and low background, like XRR, HRXRD and RSM investigations.
In addition, the PATHFINDERPlus includes an automated absorber to ensure linearity of the measured intensities.  
Perfect Powder Data - Automatically
Dynamic Beam Optimization™ (DBO)
Bruker's unique Dynamic Beam Optimization (DBO) feature sets a significant new benchmark in terms of data quality for X-ray diffraction. The automatic synchronization of motorized divergence slits, a motorized anti-scatter screen, and the variable field-of-view active detector window provides unparalleled data quality, specifically at low angles 2Ɵ. DBO is supported by all members of the LYNXEYE detector family: SSD160-2, LYNXEYE-2, and LYNXEYE XE-T, and also by the EIGER2 R 500K detector.

The LYNXEYE Family – Highest Data Quality for Any Application
LYNXEYE detectors are available for all diffractometers
The LYNXEYE family of detectors represents the height of performance in compound strip detection for all X-ray diffraction and scattering applications.​ 
The SSD160-2, LYNXEYE-2, and LYNXEYE XE-T feature advanced 500 µm silicon strip sensors, compatible with all common X-raywavelengths - from Cr to Ag - and are fully integrated with all of Bruker’s X-ray diffractometers.​ 
The LYNXEYE HE, for the D8 ADVANCE and D8 DISCOVER, offers an air-cooled CdTe sensor optimized for applications requiring Mo or Ag radiation, like pair distribution function (PDF) analysis or operando studies on battery cells.​ 
All LYNXEYE detectors are engineered to meet the highest standards in technical precision, manufacturing quality, and system/software integration - ensuring unmatched versatility, reliability, and data quality across all applications. 
SSD160-2 Detector
The SSD160-2 is the perfect entry level detector for applications from classic powder diffraction to SAXS or XRR. With 160 detector channels and an energy resolution of <1000 eV (Cu Kα), the SSD160-2 deliver excellent data quality in short measurement times. A great and cost-effective choice!
 READ MORE ON THE SSD160-2 DETECTOR
LYNXEYE XE-T Detector
For ultimate data quality choose the flagship LYNXEYE XE-T detector. Its superb energy resolution <380 eV (Cu Kα) enables the filtering of unwanted scattering, from K-beta radiation to fluorescence signal. This is crucial for lowest background data and lowest limits of detection.
 READ MORE ON THE LYNXEYE XE-T
LYNXEYE-2 Detector
With 20% more channels the LYNXEYE-2 provides an extra boost to measurement times compared to the SSD160-2. Like all detectors in this family, the LYNXEYE-2 is a robust multi-purpose, 0D – 1D – 2D detector and comes with Bruker’s unique detector guarantee.
 READ MORE ON THE LYNXEYE-2 DETECTOR
LYNXEYE HE Detector
The LYNXEYE HE detector features an air-cooled 1000 µm CdTe sensor optimized for high-energy XRD, delivery >99% detection efficiency for Cu, Mo, and Ag radiation without the need for water cooling or dry air. 
The detector’s proprietary design (patent pending) ensures reliable performance with zero defective strips guaranteed for consistent, high-quality data acquisition. 
 Read more about high-energy XRD
Key Features
LYNXEYE XE-T
Unmatched Fluorescence and Kβ Filtering
The LYNXEYE XE-T delivers the most effective suppression of unwanted diffraction signals available in a detector today. Combining an energy resolution better than 380 eV with a unique third discriminator that rejects charge sharing events, the detector removes 100% of Fe fluorescence excited by Cu radiation and suppresses Cu Kβ radiation to less than 0.1% of the Cu Kα intensity. The result is exceptionally clean diffraction data free from artifacts like absorption edges and unparalleled sensitivity for trace and minor phases. 
 READ MORE ABOUT THE LYNXEYE XE-T
LYNXEYE Family
2D scanning and BRAGG2D
A common challenge encountered during powder X-ray diffraction experiments is ensuring the specimen consists of randomly oriented crystallites with appropriate dimensions. 2D X-ray diffraction is a convenient way to visualize deviations from this ideal powder condition. It is also useful to enhance the phase-identification process by correlating line profiles and to increase quantification reliability.
All detectors of the LYNXEYE family support two ways of collecting 2D data:
On D8 ADVANCE and D8 DISCOVER diffractometers equipped with Bruker’s patented 0/90° mount, 2D data is collected in the 90° orientation using a conventional 2θ scan. With BRAGG2D, included on all diffractometers, data is measured in parafocusing beam geometry and processed with a new 2D data processing algorithm. This allows the illumination of a large specimen area with the full X-ray beam, resulting in rapid assessment of sample preparation.
 READ MORE ON BRAGG2D
 READ MORE 2D DIFFRACTION WITH THE LYNXEYE
LYNXEYE Family
Fast measurements and high dynamic range
With its high dynamic range, high count rate and fast readout times, the LYNXEYE detector family is a great choice for all applications, including materials research.
Reciprocal Space Maps (RSM) are important to characterize the structure of epitaxial multilayers and evaluate film properties – such as strain, composition and domain effects.
Using the rapidRSM™ technology, available for all LYNXEYE family detectors, RSMs are collected as a series of 1D snapshots with essentially no dead time. This dramatically reduced the required scan time to minutes or even seconds, increasing sample throughput.
For X-ray reflectometry (XRR) and high resolution XRD (HRXRD) measurements, the signal intensity varies by several orders of magnitude over the measured range. Consequently, a high dynamic range is a key detector parameter. By switching to the 90° orientation of any LYNXEYE family detector, the dynamic range increases by almost 200x, eliminating the need for absorbers – gaining speed and improving data quality.

Bruker X-ray Sources 
X-ray Source Technology is a Key Competence of Bruker AXS
Various fully integrated, state-of-the-art X-ray sources are available to generate the X-rays.
The industry-grade metal-ceramic sealed tube for line or spot focus.
The patented TWIST-TUBE for fast and easy switching between line and spot focus.
The microfocus X-ray (IµS) source boosts the intensity on small spots while consuming only very little power.
The TURBO X-RAY SOURCE (TXS) rotating anode provides highest intensities for line, spot and micro focus applications.
The revolutionary METALJET, based on liquid metal jet technology, provides unmatched X-ray source brilliance.
The High-Efficiency Turbo X-ray Source (TXS-HE) for highest intensity in point and line focus, available for D8 DISCOVER Plus.
These X-ray sources are combined with dedicated X-ray optics to efficiently capture the X-rays and turn them into an X-ray beam optimized for your application.
